newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Iridium sells $800 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Iridium sells $800 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following $800 million two-tranche 144a debt issue from Iridium LLC/Capital Corp was priced Friday via lead manager Chase Securities Inc, according to a market source.
TYPE SNR NOTES ISS PRICE 95.429 FIRST PAY DATE 1/15/1998
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 15.00 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE
NOTE: Three-year equity call for 33 percent of issue at 115.
TYPE SNR NOTES ISS PRICE 97.598 FIRST PAY DATE 1/15/1998
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 13.50 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE

NOTES: The 13 percent notes were sold as units including warrants to purchase up to one percent equity stake in Iridium World Communications Ltd, the pubically traded unit of Iridium. Three-year equity for 33 percent of the issue at 113.50.
